scope: The historic Tripura Sundari brick sanctuary and connected west assembly hall in Matabari, Udaipur, based on the pre-redevelopment appearance.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Temple trust describes the 75-foot sanctuary with a sloping Bengali hut-like roof and conical crown.

The university describes the 24-foot square outside dimension, west and north doors, four corner pillars, six wall bands, curving four-sided roof, lotus collar, and finial. It also identifies the connected assembly hall.
The architectural chapter corroborates the walls, two doorways and 75-foot height.
The 2025 public works announcement establishes the later redevelopment and replacement site amenities.
